info.title: CqrsLens 0.4.0 - see your MediatR codebase.
info.description: See your MediatR codebase: CqrsLens statically scans a .NET solution (no build required) and generates an ARCHITECTURE.md report with Mermaid diagrams of your project graph, CQRS map, layers, and DbContexts.

options.name: --output
options.description: Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (or .html) in the current directory.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Config file. Default: <path>/.cqrslens.json when present.
Settings: analysis, markers, include/exclude globs, layers, rules.

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format: md (default) or html. A .html -o path implies html.

options.name: --generated-at
options.description:
Fixed ISO-8601 timestamp for reproducible reports (tests/CI);
timing is reported as 0 ms in this mode.

options.name: --markers
options.description:
Comma-separated custom marker interface names that also count
as request roots (e.g. ICommand,IQuery,IMessage). Requests hidden
behind interfaces deriving from IRequest are always followed.

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
Compare checks with a baseline file; --strict then fails only
on errors not present in the baseline.

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description: Record current checks as the baseline, then continue.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Also write SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Also write a compact Markdown job summary.

options.name: --ci-root
options.description: Repository root used to rebase annotation/SARIF paths.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Exit with code 4 when architecture checks report an error
and the scan is complete; incomplete scans report diagnostics.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the tool version and exit.
